tei:div.tei:p: 735)༄༅/ rgyun gyis nyams len bya tshul bzhugs so/ dge'o/

736)༄༅/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ tho rangs yar langs dus dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang bas/ rang dge sbyor la bskul bas gnyid sad pa yin bsam te/ lus rnam snang chos bdun drang tha ler 'dug nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs dang*/ sgom rkyon bying rmugs 'thib gsum thams cad rlung nag po'i rnam par sna bug nas phyir song bar bsam la rlung ro 'bud/ ngag byin rlabs rgyas par bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin ltar ram/ bsdu na rang gi lce yi dbang po yi raṃ yig dmar po las me 'bar/ tha mal gyi lce dang ngag sgrib thams cad bsregs te/ 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin lce rdo rje rtse gsum par gsal ba'i dbus rar dbyangs gsal rten snying mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bsdus te lce la thim pas gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid du gyur par bsam la/ ā li kā li/ ye dhar rnams lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ kun slong 737)bcos pa ni/ da de ring nyi ma'i ( 'go ? ) 'og gang 'dir/ dge sbyor zhig sgrub dgos pa 'di ci yi don du sgrub dgos bsam na/ tshe 'di la nad gdon rkyen ngan sogs mi 'dod pa zhi ba'i don du bsgrub bsam na/ de 'jigs skyob kyi kun slong yin/ tshe 'di la/ mthun rkyen longs spyod 'dzom pa'i phyir du bsgrub bsam na/ de legs smon kun slong yin/ de gnyis tshe 'di sgrub pa'i bsam pa yin pas tshe 'di blos btang ma thub na chos byas tshad lam log 'ba' zhig du 'gro bas/ tshe 'dir sdug bsngal ci lta bu byung yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rjes sngon gyi las ngan skye ba phyi mar myong 'gyur thams cad da lta 'dir smin pa yin pas dga' bar blta/ dgos par blta/ med thabs med par blta/ de'i steng du khams sum sems can thams cad kyi rgyu sdig pa dang*/

'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin nas bdag gi sdug bsngal 'dis go chod/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsam/ tshe 'dir bde ba dang skyid pa byung na/ sngon gyi dge ba'i las cung zad bsags pa tshe 'dir smin/ phyi mar sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig pa myong ngo zhes bla ma dkon mchog gis bya btang ba yin par bsam ste/ bdag gi bde dang dge ba ma lus pa ma sems can thams cad la sbyin pa yin/ btong ba yin/ bsngos pa yin pas/ 738)de ma sems can thams cad kyi thob nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i tshogs chos su gyur cig bsam/ mdor na rnyed pa dang*/ bstod pa/ snyan grags bed skyid byung na dga'/ nor rdzas brlag pa/ smad pa/ gyod kha mchu/ na tsha sdug bsngal byung na mi dga' ba'i rtog pa med par 'jig rten chos brgyad ro snyoms pa 'di dus dang rgyun du gal che shos yin/ tshe 'di bsgrub bsam pa de mi dge ba'i kun slong yin pas dug ltar spang dgos/ lung ma bstan gyi kun slong ni/ tshe 'di phyi gang la yang mi bsam par/ rang gi don ran byung*/ bsgrub ran byung bsam pa'am/ gzhan gyis sgrub cing 'dug bdag gi bsgrub dgos bsam pa lta bu'i dge ba sgrub pa de yin pas/ de 'dra nam byung la de yi dbang du mi btang bar bcos rgyu gal che/ skyes bu chung ngu'i kun slong ni/ tshe phyi ma ngan song las thar nas mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang tsam thob pa'i ched du bsgrub bsam pa'o yin/ de srid pa bsgrub pa'i las tsam las/ dge ba rnam dag mi 'ong*/ skyes bu 'bring gi kun slong ni/ ngan song las thar gsol smos ma dgos/ mngon mtho tsam thob kyang don 'bras cher mi 'dug pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las thar nas/ rang don du zhi ba myang 'das kyi go 'phang thob pa'i 739)ched du bsgrub dgos bsam pa de yin/ des kyang theg chen gyi dge rtsa mi 'grub pas/ da dgos rgyu gang yin bsam na/

skyes bu chen po'i kun slong gzhan phan don du gnyer dgos/ de la zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa ste/ 'di ltar nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin/ sems can gyi khams la mtha' dang mu med/ de thams cad rang gi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ de yang pha ma lan re byas pas chog pa i yin bsam na/ min te/ sems can re res bdag gi ma byas pa'i grangs kyang*/ sa chen po 'di rgya shug gi tshig pa tsam gyi ril bu bsgril nas bgrangs kyang*/ sas mi 'dang pa tsam gyis pha ma byas pa'i tshe/ phan pa tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa sgo du ma nas/ skyab pa'i drin chen po sha rtag dang ldan pa yin pas/ drin chen de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag las thar bar gyur cig thar ba zhig byung na ci ma rung*/ thar ba zhig ngas bya/ thar ba zhig bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen bsam pa de yin/ zur phyi ma shos rab kyi rdzogs byang la dmigs pa ni/ sdug bsngal de dag bral nas/ bde ba gang la 'god dgos bsam na/ mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba la 'god na/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin lta bu'i go 740)'phang thob kyang rang 'phen byed kyi las bsod nams dge ba'i dngos po nam zad dang mnyam du dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal myong dgos pas/ de srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' yin/ de la bkod dgos med/ zhi bde nyan rang gi go 'phang la bkod na/ 'brum nad byang ba'i skyes bu ltar 'khor bar slar mi ldog pa yin mod kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'bras bu'i yon tan med pas de zhi bar sbyor ba'i las zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' yin/ mtha' de gnyis las 'das pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/

nam byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsgrub bsam pa dgos/ sangs rgyas go 'phang la dmigs pa 'bras bu la dam bca' ba de smon pa sems bskyed yin/ de'i ched du bdag gis dge ba bsgrub bsam pa rgyu la dam bca' ba 'jug pa sems bskyed yin/ mdor bsdu na/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral ste mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dge ba bsgrub bsam pa dgos/ de dge rtsa thabs kyis zin pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa yin/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed kyis zin na ma ṇi tshar gcig 'don yang yar sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lta bu'i grangs/ mar sems can rgya mtsho lta bu'i grangs ka 'phel 'gro bas dge rtsa 741)stobs chen por 'gro rdzas yin pas dge ba ma bsgrub na ci bya'o/ dge rtsa sna gcig bsgrubs tshar nas sems bskyed 'di 'dra re med thabs med yin/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ mdang sum mar nyal dus bla ma'i sku tshon gang bar gyur pa snying dbus pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur spyan drangs ste bzhugs pa de/ rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ tshangs bug nas yar byon te spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du dgyes ye re bzhugs pa la/ bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa lnga ni/ bla ma'i thugs ye shes chen po chos sku yin/ de'i snang cha sku gzugs/ sku de gzugs sku/ sku thugs 'byer med pa de sangs rgyas dngos yin/ sku sangs rgyas yin na mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yin/ de skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho bla ma las phar spro/ tshur bsdu na bla ma la 'dus/ rang ngo sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ de sngon byon zin pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas rang gdul ma nus/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bla ma ru sprul nas bdag 'dul ba yin/ de ltar shes nas bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa las lam rkyen gzhan gang la ma stos kyang*/

bla ma'i byin rlabs kho nas rang rgyud la rtogs pa mngon sum du 'char ba yin pas/ bla ma ma gtogs pa'i skyabs skyob pa mgon dpung gnyen su'ang med pas/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa yang nga'i bla ma yin/ rje 742)btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag na rdo rje/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ o rgyan rin po che/ rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul/ sgrub sde bka' brgyad/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs/ mtshan 'dra mi 'dra ci btags kyang*/ don rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma las gzhan med/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad kyang bla ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i rnam rol las gzhan med/ bla ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i snang cha la lha yab/ stong cha la lha yum zhes brjod pa yin/ der ma zad gzugs su snang ba/ ri rab brag khang khyim/ skyes pa bud med/ 'dre rgyal po/ btsan ma mo sogs snang tshad thams cad bla ma'i sku yi rol pa yin/ zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra thams cad gsung*/ rang gzhan gyi rtog tshogs thams cad thugs kyi rol pa las shar ba yin/ snang srid dpal ldan bla ma'i rol pa yin bsam nas gsol ba kha zhe med par snying thag pa nas btab rjes snang srid thams cad bla la 'dus/ de rang la thim pas thugs rgyud kyi yon tan thams cad lhag ma ma lus pa rang la thim byung snyam nas/ sngar 'das kyi rjes mi bcad/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa la dgag sgrub med par bzhag pas kha nang du log tsam gyis rig stongarjen pa'i ye shes zang tha le mi 'byung mi srid/ de la bca' bcos ci 'ang mi byed par 743)rang babs su ( klong ? )glod la bzhag de nas rnam rtog gcig ldang ba dang mnyam du/ bdag gis/ da res dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ 'du shes med pa'i lha ste mi ma yin pa'i mi khoms pa bzhir yang ma skyes/ 'tshe ba chos su smra ba kla klo/ sangs rgyas dang chos kyi snang ba med pa'i yul dang*/ las rgyu 'bras la yid mi ches pa'i log lta can dang*/

ngag lkugs pa smra mi shes/ yid lkugs pa 'jig rten 'khor ba'i las ka dgra 'dul gnyen skyong*/ tshong so nam sogs la nya chu nang sleb pa bzhin dpa' rtsal spyang drung 'dzom na yang*/ dam pa'i chos thos bsam sgom gsum la kha bskor dus ba gyang ngor brdas pa bzhin gyur pa de 'dra red i 'dug dpyad/ log lta can sangs rgyas nam mkhar 'phur yang dad pa/ sems can rgyu ma lug kyang snying rje med pa red 'dug nas las rgyu 'bras tshad ma 'di rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos lags pa 'jig rten na dpyid dus sa bon gang btab kyang*/ ston dus 'bras bu de ltar 'byung ba ma gtogs ( thang cig ? )tsam 'gyur ba'ang mi srid/ de bas na rgyu dge ba las 'bras bu bde ba dang*/ rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba las 'bras bu sdug sngal 'byung ba 'di yang ji srid gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su ma nub bar du nam yang bslu ba med pa la yang nas yang du nges shes bskyed nas/ rgyu 'bras la 744)yid chas pa ni yang dag pa'i lta ba zhes bya ba yin/ yid lkugs pa red 'dug na/ mi shes pa'i rgyu ni sgrib pa yin pas/ de sbyong byed gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba dang*/ shes rab bskyed pa'i lha rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin pas de la gsol ba btab/ rang 'byor lnga yi nang nas/ da lta mi yin/ chos dar sar skyes/ dbang po sgo lnga tshang yang*/ sgo gsum chos 'gal gyi spyod pa byas na las mtha' log pa yin pas/ phyi yo byad la chags pa skyes na/ rang cag rnams thog ma med pa nas/ gzhi chos dbyings spros pa bral ba las gzhi snang thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos pa rang ngo ma shes pas/ ma rig pa 'dis bzung nyes byas pas rang bzhin gyi 'od lnga nub/ gzugs brnyan gyi 'od lnga bag la chags te med bzhin du snang ba'i med pa gsal snang 'khrul pa 'di byung ba las/ dpyad na/ rags pa rdul phran/ rdul pran cha med/ cha med rang bzhin/ med pa'i bar du dpyad kyang ma grub/

de 'dzin pa'i sems 'di'ang 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi skad cig ma'i rig pas dpyad na ma grub/ ma grub bzhin du snang tsam ma 'gags pa'i sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'i snang ba 'di la/ bzang po gang la chags/ 745)ngan pa gang la byed/ gang la sdang*/ 'khrul snang stong gzugs chu zla 'dra ba 'di la/ 'khrul pa a lhan ko lhan gyi rgyu nor rdzas la chags/ yar dkon mchog la mchod pa mi bra/ mar ngan slong la gtong mi bra/ gzhan la nor rdzas bzang po zhig 'dug na/ de ngas lon thabs ci drag bsam 'dug na/ mig bsod chen gyi mi mthong ba med/ lag gsod zad kyis len rgyu med pas/ bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ de rnams sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu ste/ nga'i tshe rabs kyi ma rgan yin pas/ de rnams la ngas bsgrub ma dgos/ 'bad ma dgos par 'byor pa dang bde skyid yod pa nga re dga'/ de bas kyang lhag tsam bzang tsam 'byung bar shog bsam dgos/ rang la cung zad yod pa li li'i stug pa gser du sgom mi 'dug par/ da lta'i dus 'dir kha la za rgyu ma ltog tsam/ rgyab tu gyon rgyu ma 'khyags tsam med na thabs ci yod/ de las yar lhag cung zad yod tshe mnga' thang chos phyogs su bskor ba las/ shi spar 'tham mi 'dug par/ blo phug chos la gtad/ chos phug sprang la gtad/ sprangs phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs grog stong la gtad/ khrel med rdo rje 746)sngon du btang*/ ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ theb med rdo rje rjes su bzhag mi gral nas bud/ khyi gral du snyogs nas/ lha gral du thon pa'i jo bo bka' gdams pa'i phug nor bcu po rang rgyud la 'byor nges pa mi byed re snyam du dam bca' dgos ma gtogs rgyu nor rdzas 'd-i dang po gsog mi thub/ bar du bsrung mi thub/ tha ma dgras brlag nor rdzas 'di'i chad du mna' za/ gtam snogs/ sdom pa dam tshig thams cad chu la pho/ bla mar ser mo rnams dang*/ khyad par sprul sku yin zer ba rnams chung rta kha ma thub pa'i dus nas/

dkor rjes la byon/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyong*/ bskyed rim bsnyen tshad/ rdzogs rim rdzogs chen sogs nyams len rgyud la sbyor ba sne gcig med par/ tha na de nyin cho ga de yang kha yengs mig yengs ma gtogs/ kha nag yid nag sprod shes pa de yang legs par mi 'don/ gsol chas dang 'bul ba sogs che na dga'/ chung na sdug de ring ci rag 'ong bsam/ sha za so la chas pa bzhin za rlom/ rnyed rlom ngang du mi tshe 'da' ba rang lta bu rnams/ dkor ngo sems la phogs/ dad pa dag snang*/ skyo shas nges 'byung*/ snying rje byang chub sems sogs cung zad yod pa shul 747)med du gyur/ phu ya gi/ mda' ma ki thams cad nga dang 'dra 'dra yin bsam nas log lta mi zad pa skyed/ zhe sdang khong khro me ltar 'bar/ khyod kyi kha ngo la yod rgyu de rna i red tsam zer na yang*/ nga la bsnyad byung*/ nga la sdang byung*/ nga rang ni thob chen po yin bsam pa sogs bsam ngan kho na skyed/ bar du dkor kha la phog phu ya de ma red/ mda' mi de ma red/ lta ba ma red/ grub mtha' ma red sogs las ngan tshab chen bsags/ tha ma dkor mje la phog bka' sdom pa dam tshig thams cad nyams nas dmyal ba'i gting rdor gyur pa yang rgyu nor rdzas 'dis byas pas/ rang nor la chog shes pa dang*/ gzhan nor la 'dod pa chung ba gal che/ nor zhes pa blo nor 'gro pa/ 'phyugs 'gro pa yin pas nor zhes bya/ blo nyes 'gro pa yin pas nor zhes bya/ grong chog byon dus kyang*/ nad pa nad bdag dang bcas pa/ shi bo bshed ma dang bcas pa la dmigs nas bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa mdzad na mi'i gdan thog nas rang gi tshogs bsags yin/ gsol drang 'dren/ yon 'bul ba sogs kyang che na mi dga'/ 748)chung na mi sdug ci sbyin 'ong yang dkon mchog gi sku drin yin bsam nas bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag re mdzad dgos/ nang sems can la chags na/ chags pa'i gzhi rang re skyes pas bud med dang*/ bud med kyis skyes par chags pa yin pas/

gang chags yul de ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi rna 'dren/ nyin par gyi 'ug rgan khra mgo ma yin bsam nas de phyogs la mig shor mi nyan/ de rgyu bsgrub na 'grub dka' ba/ ngo bo mi gtsang ba/ 'bras bu gnod pa mang ba/ dkar ba'i rgyu ni chu ser/ dmar ba'i rgyu ni khrag don du mi gtsang ba'i rdzas ngan so drug gi rkyal pa/ bkru ba dang phyi ba sogs ma byas par gcer bu langs ste rgyug 'ongs na gdon 'ong lta bu 'jigs shing skrag pa'i rang bzhin de la chags pa ni phag mi gtsang ba la chags pa dang 'dra ba yin/ 'o na rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung rnams nas gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya sten byar gsungs yod do nyams na/ de 'dra'i sten du rung ba ni gu ru rin po ches/ rgya gar na man+dha ra ba dang*/ bod na ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis las ma rnyed gsungs yod na gu ru rin po che sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i yon tan ldan pa des ma rnyed na rang res mi rnyed ngo ma yin/ sngags 749)lam ji lta ba bzhin dgos na/ skyil krung bzhi ldan la brten nas 'phags pa'i ye shes bde blag tu rnyed pa zhig dgos/ deng sang sngags rgan ral pa can tshos kyang bu bu mo mang po spel/ bu re res kyang bud med thang gang re la rigs rgyud spel/ bu mo re res skyes pa thang gang re dang 'grogs pa las/ des rang rgyud la yon tan bskyed pa dang*/ rigs brgyud kyis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don byed pa brgya lam res 'ga' las mi snang na sngags lam mtshan nyid pa 'ang dka'/ der ma zad bud med dang 'grogs pa'i phyir pad+ma'i gter ston yin par khas 'che nas/ rdzun rgyab gu ru rin po che la bcol ba'i las ngan tshabs chen gsog pa de 'dra yang mang tsam yod shas che bas/ gu ru rin po che'i gter ston tshad ldan yin na/ gter babs pa dang gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa gdeng ldan du 'gyur pa zhig dgos te/ deng sang gter ston yin zer ba phal nas dngos gzhi sems 'tshol nas brtsams rim pa bzhin bla rgan zhig la dri dgos par snang ba'ang the tshom gyi gnas yin/

bud med ces pa de'i dbang du shor na de las bud mi shes pas bud med/ nag mo zhes dkar po'i yon tan gyi 750)lo tog thams cad ser bas 'joms pa ltar nag por gtong bas na nag mo zhes bya la/ de brten ma dgos na chags med rin po ches bod sdom gcig ma gsungs pa ltar/ skyon brgya yod kyang yon tan gcig gi zil gyis gnon pa yin/ de'i dbang du song na yon tan brgya yod kyang skyon gcig gi dbang du 'gro ba la de las thu ba 'jig rten na med pas/ de'i dbang du mi shor ba re nam yang gzab dgos/ de'i gnyen po 'dul ba ltar na mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes dgu dang*/ byang sems ltar na ma dang sring mo'i 'du shes dang*/ sngags ltar na lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du blta dgos/ de las gzhan du gyur pa'i grogs rnams kyang*/ deng sang dus snyigs ma lnga bdo bas sems can rnams rgyud drang zhing mdzangs pa su'ang med pas chos mthun grogs zhes bya ba ni srid mtha' ma bkag pa tsam las gzhan dag ni sdig pa'i grogs nyag cig yin pas/ dang por yid mthun mthun/ ngag 'khri 'khri 'dra yang*/ 'grogs yun ring na khos nga yi rgyus lon te/ kho bas nga mtho na phrag dog byed/ khod nga nga mnyam na 'gran sems byed/ kho las nga dma' na brnyas bcos byed/ kho'i don ngas bsgrub kyang mi 'grub la/ nga'i don khos kyang mi byed pas/ 751)des na 'phrad na dga' ba tsam gyis yid mgu bar byas te/ kho dang mi 'grogs par thag ring por byol te/ rang nyid gcig pu dge sbyor gyi ngang*/ bya dang ri dwags 'grogs na bde ba/ chu dang lo ma dka' thub kyi zas dang ldan pa dgra dang rkun po'i glags cor med pa/ rig pa ngang gis dwangs shing nyams dga' ba'i dben pa'i ri ngogs su ngag smra ba bcad de gcig pur gnas par bya dgos/ yul yid du mi 'ong ba la brten nas khong khro dang zhe sdang lang na/ khong khro'i rang 'bras dmyal ba/ bzod pa'i rang 'bras sangs rgyas yin/

dge rtsa 'dzad pa'i rgyu/ dge rtsa log par bsngos pa dang*/ gzhan la dge ba ngoms pa/ dge ba sngar byas pa la 'gyod pa skyes pa dang*/ khong khro ba dang bzhi las khong khro 'dis bskal chen stong phrag tsam du sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims bsrungs ba la sogs pa'i dge rtsa thams cad rmings med du 'joms pas/ bla mar ser mo'i dge rtsa brlag dpyad zhig la khong khro las thu ba gang yang med pas khong khro mug sod byed dgos ma gtogs/ khong khro ngo ma skyes tshar dus bzod pa sgom thub zer ba dka' bas/ da nang yar langs dus nas sems mi bde ka re zhig yod na de khong 752)khro'i rgyu yid mi bde'i kha zas zhes pa yin pas de ring nga'i dge rtsa bsreg ngo ma yin pas/ las ci la thug rkyang khong khro mi byed bsam nas/ de'i nyin par su gcig med sa zhig la sdod pa'am/ min kyang ngag smra ba bcad nas bzod pa sgom dgos/ mdor na dam pa'i chos ni mi 'tshe ba'o zhes pas/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la spang blang thams cad rigs bsdu na/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spang ba 'di kho nar 'du bas gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong ba so thar gyi sdom pa zhes dngos su srog gcod pa ni/ srog gcod gong na sdig gzhan med ces des na nyes pa che ba zhig las thabs ci yod/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sems can gcig gi ba spu'i khung bu zhig la'ang mi gnod pa zhig dgos bsam pa'i kha zhe gnyis med dam bca' byed/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas kyang srog la thug kyang sems can la gnod 'tshe rdung rdeg rku 'phrog ngan smras thams cad spang ci thub/ sems can la phan ci thogs kho na lhur len na/ sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa/ rgyal ba mnyes pa'i thabs gzhan med/ ces gsung pa lags pas sems can la gnod pa 753)spangs na so thar sdom pa de yin/ sems can la phan pa bsgrub na byang sems sdom pa de yin/ sems can la gnas skabs phan pa dang mthar thug bde ba'i phyir du bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'ang de yin/

'gro ba'i don sgrub pa'ang de yin ma gtogs/ deng sang bstan 'dzin skyes bu yin zer ba 'ga' res/ 'dzin rgyu sangs rgyas bstan pa bshad 'grub gnyis la than du blta/ 'dzin mi dgos rgyu'i khrims lugs zhig 'dzin nas pha ma sems can rnams gnam la dpyang*/ lcag tshan brab/ khrims kho nar gtugs nas nga bstan 'dzin skyes bu yin zer zhing snang ste de su'i bstan 'dzin yin mi shes/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi bstan pa 'dzin lugs ni de ma red/ ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar ni/ ston pa zhi ba 'khor zhi ba/ ston pa dul ba 'khor dul ba/ tha na chibs rgyu'i rta rgan zhig med pa 'di sems can la gnod pa skyel ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs min par dgongs nas ma chibs pa yin gyi/ ston pa thabs sdug nas chibs rgyu ma rnyed pa ga la yin/ des na sngon byon ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug bdag cag gi nyams len dang sbyar nas bstan pa'i bla mi btsong*/ dkon mchog gi rkang mi 'dren pa re gal che/ mdor na mi dge ba'i rtog pa re skye ba dang 754)mnyam du 'bur 'joms la btang*/ dge ba'i rtog pa re yang nas yang du bskyed/ de la blang dor gyi gnas mi brjed pa'i dran pa sgo ba lta bus rang gi sems rgyud la rtog pa sna re skyes kyang*/ blang rgyu'i dge ba red dang*/ spang rgyu'i sdig red ngos zin par byed/ sgo gsum gyi gnas la brtag pa shes bzhin so pa lta bus rang gi dge ba dang mthun par sgrub dang*/ mi dge ba dang mthun par sgrubs shing 'dug rtog dpyod rgyob/ blang dor gyi gnas la gzob pa lhur len pa bag yod bag ma gsar pa lta bus mi dge ba'i bsam sbyor re byung na de ma thag tu spang*/ dge ba'i bsam sbyor re byung na gong nas gong du btang na las mtha' mi log pa'i thabs yin/ rten la dad pa ni/ spyir dkon mchog gi rten sogs mjal dus sems spro sing nge 'ong ba dang ba'i dad pa/

dge ba bsgrub 'dod/ sdig pa spang 'dod pa 'dod pa'i dad pa/ dkon mchog dang rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa yid ches kyi dad pa yin pas/ yid ches kyi dad pa thob pa la rgyu mtshan cung zad ma shes na mi 'ong bas/ mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la ci tsam go ba brlabs che na/ de tsam kha nang du log nas bsgom dus gegs 755)dang gol sa thams cad 'gag rang grol du 'gro ba yin mod kyi/ tha na yang byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i thabs su spyod 'jug so byang sngags gsum gyi spang blang ngo shes byed du sdom gsum rnam nges/ sngags kyi 'gro yul tsam shes pa la rgyud gsang snying*/ dam tshig lam rim gyi 'gros shes byed du yid bzhin mdzod/ yon tan mdzod/ ngal gso skor gsum tsam ma shes thabs med/ de rnams la go ba gting phyin pa zhig rnyed na lam gnad thams cad kyi mthar thug pa snga 'gyur rnying ma pa'i khyad chos 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen mo man ngag gsang ba snying thig yin par nges shes gting nas skyes 'ong na/ rang skal rdo lu yin kyang mur chog pa red 'ong*/ de ma yin par a this chu rdo nang sleb pa lta bus gar yang mi 'ong*/ gzhan 'byor lnga yi nang nas/ sangs rgyas byon/ chos gsungs/ bstan pa gnas kyang*/ bstan pa zhugs pa tsam la/ gzhan rkyen bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa sbyin nas thob pa yin kyang*/ zhugs pa med pa/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las thar 'dod kyi blo bcos ma min pa'i nges 'byung dang*/ byang sems la rang 'dod yid byed 756)kyi rtog pa dgrar blta/ skyon du blta/ phung bar blta/ brlag par bltas nas yul phud/ rjes 'don byed nas/ gzhan phan gyi blo bcos ma min pa dang*/ sngags la/ snang grags rig pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad chos nyid kyi rang gdangs/ snang srid gzhir bzhugs kyi sangs rgyas la gzhir bzhengs su gsal btab pa las skad cig kyang mi 'da' ba zhig med thabs med yin/

bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid mdzad dang ldan pa la ci gsung gi bka'i zur tsam yang mi bcag par mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis sten pa ste/ dal 'byor bco brgyad po 'di dag tshang na dga' ba bsgom/ ma tshang na sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs la 'bad/ da res sngon bsags bsod nams rnam par dag pas chos sgrub pa'i lus bstan 'di lta bu thob kyang*/ phyin chad rgyu dpe grangs gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad na rnyed par dka'/ lus rten 'di'ang nam 'chi mi shes/ 'chi dus chos ma gtogs phan pa med/ 'khor ba dang ngan song du lhung shor na de las thabs sdug pa ci yod/ mi skye ba'i gding ni med/ las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas da lta rang res mi dge ba ni rtsed mo'i zhor tsam la gsog 757)dge ba bsags pa'i grangs nyung*/ cung zad dge ba re la gzhol yang de'i tshe bying rmugs gnyid dbang kho na la shor/ sdig pa'i 'bras bu ni/ byas pa chud mi za' rang gi gnya' ltag la smin/ dge ba ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ bde ba 'dod kyang phan pa med/ de bas na skyabs kyi mthar thug bla ma dkon mchog la zhu bas/ mthor btang*/ dmar btang*/ skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang khyed mkhyen/ khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs dang skyob pa/ mgon dang dpung gnyen mi btsal/ khyed kyi rjes su slob nas bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab/ sngar bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba dug drag po khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la skyabs su bzung ste/ mar gyur sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bdag kho nas sbyong snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa rten gyi stobs/ phyin chad nyes pa 'dzem thub pa rnams srog la babs kyang mi byed/ 'dzem ma thub pa rnams 'dzem thub pa zhig byin gyis brlab dgos snyam sor chud pa'i stobs/

rdo rje 758)sems dpa'i sku yi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus phyi nang bkrus pa'i khu ba sa 'og sod de 'chi bdag gshin rje ngoms/ bdud rtsi'i lhag mas lus shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar gyur par mos nas yig brgya 'bum ther ram/ rgyun du nyer gcig re bzlas pas nyes ltung byin gyis rlabs te 'phel ba rgyun chad/ slar 'od du zhu ste rang nyid rdor sems su gsal ba'i 'od zer spro bsdus snod bcud lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pas yig drug bzla ba gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs/ lus longs spyod dge rtsas mtshon te snang tshul sprul sku'i bkod pa/ gnas tshul longs sku'i zhing*/ khyab byed chos sku'i zhing dang bcas pa blos blangs te maṇ+ḍal du 'bul ba dang*/ khyad par bdag tu bzung ba'i gzhi lus/ de la mkho ba'i longs spyod dang*/ de grub byed rgyu dge ba dang bcas pa dkar 'gyed bdud rtsi'i ngo bo/ khra 'gyed 'dod yon sna tshogs/ dmar 'gyed sha khrag rus gsum las mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' khyab par spros te/ dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ mgon po yon tan mgron ye shes dang las kyi chos skyong*/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron mkha' khyab sems can/ bgegs rigs lan chags mgron sngon gyi bu lon chags pa thams cad la 'phul bas/ 759)yar mgron rnams mnyes pas tshogs rdzogs/ sdig sgrib dag byin rlabs thob/ mar mgron rnams mnyes pas lan chags byang*/ nad gdon bar chad zhi/ 'chi ba bslus/ pho thams cad spyan ras gzigs/ mo thams cad rje btsun sgrol mar gyur par mos pa ku sā li'i tshogs bsags yin/ snang yul zangs mdog dpal ri'i dbus/ rang nyid mtsho rgyal/ mdun mkhar bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba la/ dbyings na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba srag bcas spyan drangs nas thim pa la lus zhing rdul dang mnyam par phyag 'tshal/ dngos 'byor gyis mtshon yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin gyis mchod/

sdig grib lce thog 'dus par dag pa'i bshags pa/ zag bcas zag med kyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang*/ zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can ma stongs bar du bzhugs su gsol ba/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba yan lag bdun pa dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa lngas gsol gdab/ gnas bzhi'i yig 'bru las 'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag lam bzhi sgom pa'i snod du rung*/ gnas skabs rig 'dzin bzhi dang*/ mthar thug sku bzhi 'grub pa'i skal ba thob byung bsam/ mthar rang lus 'od kyi thig ler gyur pa bla ma la thim pa'am/ bla ma 'od zhu gang 760)rung bya/ ༈ bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim bsgom na/ brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun song nas/ 'gal rkyen bsal ba la/ rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis dkar gtor bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho gnas bdag dang sa lha la byin pas sa gzhi slong ba dang mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phrin las bcol/ bgegs gtor 'dod yon sprin 'phro ba nag phyogs bgegs rigs la byin nas bar chad mi byed par bka' bsgo/ gal te glags lta ba rnams ye shes kyi rig rtsal khro tshogs mtshon cha me dpung gis bsdigs nas stong gsum gyi pha mthar bskrad/ khro tshogs mtshon me slar 'dus/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba/ brtse mo rdo rje'i tog rdo rje'i thag pas bsnol mar bcings pa'i bar nas khro tshogs mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ khor yug me dpung gis g.yogs pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pas glags mi rnyed pa'i rang bzhin du bsam/ 'di bar brda sgo/ phyag bshags pa/ dam bca' rnams 'byung ba ltar na/ ma rig gzung 'dzin gyis ye shes rang snang bsgribs pa'i rang zhal phye zhing*/ dbyings ye zung du 'jug pa yin lugs shes pa'i don dam pa'i phyag dang*/

nyon shes bag chags kyi sgrib pa/ sgrib gzhi bde gshegs snying po rang ngo shes pa'i ngang du bshags pa dang*/ ji srid mthar thug 761)gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon du ma gyur par lam bden ye shes phyag rgya nam yang mi gtong bar dam bca' ba'o/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa la/ 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi rten dang brten pa'i byin rlabs bdag gnas yo byad la bstim zhing*/ mchod rdzas rnams ye shes rang snang gi mchod sprin zad mi shes pa mkha' khyab du spro pas rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa skong nus su gyur par mos pa'o/ dngos gzhi la/ de ting ni/ chos thams cad nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang la bzhag kun ting ni/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po bsgom/ rgyu ting ni/ stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa sa bon gang yin bsgom/ bskyed tshul la sgong skyes sbyong byed rgyas pa chen po'i bskyed rim/ rigs bde gshegs snying po'i che ba 'byin pa'i phyir bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba dang*/ de bzhin bshegs pa'i gdung rgyud mi chad pa'i phyir gzhan gyi sras su bdag bya ba'i tshul dang*/ mngal skyes sbyong byed pha rgyud ltar rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed/ ma rgyud ltar mngon byang lnga bskyed/ drod gsher skyes sbyong byed sngags brjod pa tsam gyis bskyed pa/ rdzus skyes sbyong byed skad cig 762)dran rdzogs rnams su yod pa las/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed ltar na/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng*/ rdo rwa me ri/ dur khrod pad 'khor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor gdugs tog dang bcas pa/ nang du lha so so'i lha gnas khri dang bcas pa'i khar rgyu yi sa bon babs pa las phyag mtshan gang yin gsal ba thugs phyag mtshan gyi cho ga de sa bon gyis mtshan par gsal ba gsung yig 'bru'i cho ga de las 'or zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas/

slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad gsal ba sku yongs rdzogs kyi cho gas bskyed pa'o/ zhal phyag rgyan chas rnams rang rang gi gzhung las rtogs dgos/ dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sku lus gang*/ lhag ma spyi bo'i gnas lngar 'khyil ba las rigs lnga sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal btab/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon 763)gyur gyi dkyil 'khor rten brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ bskyed pa'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bstim te bzhugs su gsol/ thugs ka nas tha mal pa'i lus su spros pa dang sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas phyag 'tshal bas sgrib pa dag ste thugs kar bsdu/ slar thugs ka nas rang lus dang gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo spros pa gcig las bye ba brgya stong mang por sprul nas nam mkha'i khams gang ba rnams kyis mchod rdzas thogs te mchod pa dang*/ sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i sprin phung*/ rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho rnams mchod pas dug gsum gnas stongs/ mchod pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams lha yab yum so sor 'khril ba'i sbyor mchod/ khams gsum gyi nga bdag bsgral nas bstab pa'i sgrol mchod/ 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang bskyang ba'i de kho na'i mchod pa/ yon tan rjes su bsngags pa'i glu dbyangs dang sbrel bas dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa brjod pa bstod pa'i mchod pa/ mthar mchod lha thugs kar 764)bsdu/ dbang don dang*/ gtor bzlog sogs mdun bskyed dgos pa'i rigs la/ dang por dkyil 'khor bskyed bzlas bsnyen pa dang*/ de bsdus nas slar dkyil 'khor bskyed bzlas sgrub pa'i tshul du bya ba dang*/ 'di skabs 'dzab khang dbye nas/ mdun bskyed me long la gzugs brnyan tshul du bskyed pa dang bdag bskyed bzlas pa stong tshig bcas grub mtshams mdun bskyed gsar du bskyed chog rgyas par sbrel ba dang*/

spyan 'dren gyi mgor bdag bskyed mdun bskyed tshig ris so sor bskyed nas spyan 'dren man lhan cig tu bya ba dang*/ cho ga tshig ris gcig gis bdag mdun so sor bskyed pa sogs rnying ma'i phyogs 'dir 'dra min mang du snang ba cho ga de'i tshig dngos shugs las ci bstan dang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes gang yin ltar byed pa las mtha' gcig tu nges pa med/ lha sku sgom pa de'ang spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par gsal ba rnam pa gsal ba/ dbyings ye shes gnyis su med pa rnam pa rtags phyag rgya'i lha skur shar ba'i nges 765)pa drangs ba rnam dag dran pa/ 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi rgyal ba rnams dang bla ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin 'di nyid yin no snyam pa nga rgyal brtan pa ste bskyed pa sku'i gzer thugs srog sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba kyi li li 'khor bar bsam pa dang*/ yab yum zhal sbyor can yin na/ yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal brgyud/ gsang ba nas tshur 'or ba'am/ sna bug g.yon nas brgyud lte ba nas 'or ba bying ba'i gnyen po dang*/ gsang ba nas brgyud zhal nas 'or ba'am/ lte ba nas brgyud sna bug g.yas nas 'or ba bar ma chad pa bsgom pa rgod pa'i gnyen po yin pas dmigs pa dang sbrags sngags bzla ba snying po sngags kyi gzer/ 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdu/ sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ snod bcud dag pa lha'i gyur pas bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar 'ur ru ru bzla bar bsam pa dang*/ yang 'od zer gyis zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po spyi dang*/ khyad par 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud bsdu ba/ nor dang longs spyod dbang du bsdu ba sogs/ 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa bar ma chad du bsgom/ 766)sems thang chad de 'phror mi btub pa dang*/ zang thal rjen pa'i ngang skyangs te bcos slad med par mnyam par bzhag pa dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer/

yang rnam rtog 'phro ba dang*/ sngar ltar dmigs pa bya zhing dpyad 'jog spel ma 'di las dang po'i skabs su shin du legs/ stong tshig mchod bstod sogs bya/ dmigs pa gong dang 'dra/ gsol ka 'daun pa'i tshe mchod rdzas spyi dang*/ khyad par gtor ma rlung me thod sgyed steng*/ kā pa la'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ rten rdzas/ sgrub rdzas/ skong rdzas/ rang rang gang la gang dgyes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter zad mi shes pa 'jo bas mkha' dbyings khyab par bsam/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rdo ra me ri'i nang du chos skyong so so'i gzhal yas lha dang bcas pa gsal btab/ spyan drangs te bzhugs pas gtor ma rol bas dgyes te ci 'dod pa'i phrin las thogs med du sgrubs par bsam pa'o/ tshogs byin rlabs ni/ rang gi phung po dang tshogs gtor gyi ma dag pa'i dri ma ram̐ las mes bsreg yam̐ las rlung gis gtor/ kham̐ las chus bkrus/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i 767)ngang las tshogs gzhong pad+ma'i snod du tshogs rdzas rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum gyi rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi sprin 'phro bar bsam/ oṃ gyis mang zhing rgya che/ āḥs lha'i bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan par/ hūm̐ gis gang 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur pa la/ tshogs zhing 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bla ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar 'khod pa'am/ rang gi bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis med bzhugs pa la/ tshogs rdzas las mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te spyir mchod pa dang*/ bye brag tshogs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin las 'dod yon lnga'i sprin gyis dang po mchod pas tshogs rdzogs/ rang bzhin sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi ngo bo rnam pa dgyes rgu'i mchod sprin 'bul ba bar pa bshags pas sdig sgrib byang*/ rang gi ma rig gzung 'dzin rnam rtog la khams sum gyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sems 'khrul snang dang bcas pa bkugs la rang rig ye shes rang ngo shes pas bsgral te/

sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du stobs pas tha ma bsgral mchod kyis 'khor 768)ba gnas stongs/ tshogs zhing lha tshogs rnams kyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi'i ros tshims par bsam pa sbyor mchod dang*/ skong rdzas rnams 'jig rten 'das ma 'das pa'i 'dod yon lnga rang bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa mi 'char ba med pa sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bas thugs dam bskang bas dgyes pa'i phul du phyin par bsam/ de dag ni tshogs dang gtor ma mchod rdzas su shes pa'o/ de nas tshogs rdzas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub zad pa med par 'jo ba lha'i rang bzhin/ nang gi lhar gsal ba sad par mos pas lha la lha thim cing 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ lhag ma 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ma tshogs rnams la bsngos pas sngon gyi dam bca' rjes su dran te phrin las sgrubs par dmigs/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ sngon gyi dam bca' dang zhal bzhes thams cad da lta mdzad pa'i dus la bab pas mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab pa yin/ gsol ka'i 'bul gtor sogs la/ spyir rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'khrul sems dang bcas pa/ khyad par 'khrul 769)snang rang gar bzung*/ 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du gyur/ ma 'ongs sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor las nam yang thar ba med pa'i rang gi tshe rabs kyi pha ma/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i las ngan tshabs chen bsags pa 'di rnams thabs zhi ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bral ba ni bdag gis bya ma nus pas/ de dag gi rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du drangs te bsgral bya gnas kyi 'tshengs ba tshe bsod nams rang gi tshe'i snon mar blang nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don bsgrub bsam pa rnal 'byor pa tshe lhag gis 'tshengs ba/ sha khrag nang gi rig 'dzin dge bdun rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang rnams rang gi bstan pa srung bar chos skyong gi tshul du bstan pa rnams la stobs pas dam can sha khrag gi 'tshengs pas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ bstan 'dzin gyi sku tshe srings/ bdag cag dam tshig can rnams kyi 'gal skyen sel/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ 'phral dang yun gyi 'od don lhun gyi grub pa'i phrin las mdzad byung snyam pa'o/ chad tho zhes/ dkyil 'khor gnyen po'i srung ma rnams kyis 770)sngon dpal chen po'i spyan sngar ma 'ongs pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs shing dam tshig ldan pa'i ci bcol las mi sgrub re zhes khas chod blangs/ mna' tho bcas mdzad pa da res bka' drin ma chung zhes gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ brtan ma ni/ o rgyan chen pos bod kyi so kha bsrung zhing mu stegs kyi sgo 'phrang sdams par bskos pa'i gangs can bod kyi yul lha thams cad kyi rgyal po'i yang rgyal po brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol bas/ de dag gi g.yog po dge bsnyen nyer gcig mgur lha bcu gsum/ thang lha spom ra sogs sgo srung dang*/ rdul phyag pa lta bu'i bran g.yog rnams dpon po gdan 'dren dus zhabs phyi g.yog 'khor rang shugs kyis 'ong ba bzhin de rnams la mtha' dmag kla klo 'byung po'i sgo 'phrang bsdom par las la bcol ba yin/ bro mnan ni/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan pas byang chub kyi sems ma skyes kyi bar du ldang ba med par mnan pa'o/ de nas bskyal/ ja chang 771)gi dod du/ rjes chog mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa/ bshags pa rnams dmigs pa gong dang 'dra/ dngos grub blang ba 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi bla ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang byin rlabs rang la thob pas sa dang lam gyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs nas tshe gcig gi rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'grub pa'i dngos grub thob byung bsam pa'o/ rgyas par spro na dbang chog bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa 'di/ rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa gsar du thob pa dang 'dra/

nyam chags nyes ltung sbyong ba la 'di las lhag med pas mdor bsdus sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbang len gyis go chod pa yin kyang rgyas par spro na dbang rdzas sogs 'dzom na legs kyang*/ ma 'dzom kyang dmigs pa kho nas don grub pa yin pas/ 'di'i skabs sam/ gong du tshogs drangs pa'i mgo bdag 'jug gi dbang len grub na legs pas/ de ltar na/ dbang rdzas 'dzom na/ bsnyen pa'i gsham du rnam bum dang*/ las bum sgrub/ ma 'dzoms tshe mi dgos/ 'bras bu mthar phyin mngon du 772)gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rang gi bde gshegs snying po ngo bo ye dag yon tan lhun grub/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha dbang zhu ba'i yul du byas/ glo bur 'khrul rtog gis sbags pa'i sems sems byung slob ma'i rnam pas/ khrus kyis sdig sgrib bkru/ bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad/ maṇ+ḍal gyis tshogs bsags/ gsol ba 'debs pas dad pa'i yul la gnang ba sbyin pas thugs rje 'jug yan lag bdun gyis tshogs bsags/ sgrib pa sbyong*/ bsod nams spel/ so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa bzung bas sngar nyam chags byung ba gso/ gsar du rgyud sdom ldan du 'gyur/ ye shes dbab pa/ dbang don gyi ye shes mngon du rtogs pa'am rtogs nges nus ldan du byas/ bum pa'i dbang gis snod bcud lha'i 'khor lor rdzogs/ gsang ba'i dbang gis rlung sems las su rung*/ shes rab kyis thig le dbab zlog 'dren dgram la rang dbang gyur/ tshig dbang gis khregs chod kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes byung bsam pas sngags sdom gsar du thob/ sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa bkang*/ 773) de bskang bas so byang gnyis kyi nyes sgrib shugs la dag yon tan lhan cig rdzogs/ dam tshig mdor bsdus te khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod bla ma dkyil 'khor la phul/ mthar dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar rang la bstim/ de nas brtan bzhugs ni/ tshogs mgron gyi ye shes pa sku gsung thugs rten la bstim/

dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu'o/ de yan chad kyis mar 'khor ba'i dus na 'chi ba'i 'od gsal ngo ma shes/ srid pa bar do dri za pha ma'i mngal du zhugs/ btsas nas da lta 'chi nad kyis ma zung tshun gyi skye ba'i bag chags sbyong zhing dag yar sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skus mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'gro don mdzad pa sogs kyi rten 'brel gzhi la bsgrigs pas yon tan rdzogs rung du byas pa'o snyam nas dag rdzogs gnyis bsgom dgos/ des lam gong ma zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes brtan pa'i smin byed du 'gro ba yin/ de nas lhar snang bsdu ba ni/ dag pa'i snod bcud gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'khor 774)rnams la/ de gtso bo la/ de thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba brgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa la/ de dwangs ma'i thugs srog la/ de 'ang mas nas yar rim par thim nas/ mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsam pa rjes gzhig yin/ de'i dmigs pa gom po yod na gzugs snang thams cad 'ja' yal ba/ sgra grags thams cad 'brug sgra yal ba/ dran rtog thams cad nam mkha' la sprin yal pa ltar bsgom na ril gzhig yin/ de'i rjes su dus gsum gyi rtog pa phra rags dang ma 'dres pa'i rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes ngang bskyang*/ des mar 'khor ba'i dus na 'chi ka'i 'byung ba'i thim rim snang mched thob pa nyer thob rdzogs pa'i gzhi yi 'od gsal ngo mi shes pa'i bag chags sbyong zhing dag yar sangs rgyas chos kyi sku snang gsal ye shes lnga gzhi la thim pa'i dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ dag bya mthar thug pa dag rtogs bya mthar thug pa rtogs/ gang rtogs byed kyi rtsal gzhi thim du gyur pa'i rten 'brel gzhi la 'gṛgs te yon tan ma lus rdzogs/ lam gong ma zhi gnas dngos des don gyi 775)ye shes rgyud la 'dren pa'i smin byed du 'gro/ slar ldang ba/ rtog pa zhig 'phro ba dang mnyam du skad cig gis gtso bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bu'i lhar ldang ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*/

lus rdo rje'i go chas gtams pa gsal gdab/ des mar 'khor ba'i dus na/ chos nyid bar do'i rang snang ngo ma shes/ srid pa bar dor kha 'khyams/ tshe phyi mar mtshams sbyor ba'i bag chags dag cing sbyong*/ yar sangs rgyas kyi dus na/ thugs rje'i gdangs g.yos nas phyi gsal rang snang longs sku dang*/ phyed sprul longs sku sogs kyi yon tan gzhi la rdzogs/ rang lam gong ma lhag mthong 'am/ dag dang ma dag pa'i sgyu lus kyi smin byed du 'gro/ bsngo smon bkra shis ni/ gang bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ bdag gi thun 'di'i skabs su nyams su blangs pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon te/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i zag med kyi dge rtsa/ sems can thams cad kyi zag bcas kyi dge rtsa/ sngar bsags zin pa/ ma 'ongs pa 776)na bsag par 'gyur ba/ da lta gsog bzhin pa'i dge rtsa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdom nas/ gang du bsngo na/ ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te mtha' gnyis las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du/ tshul ji ltar sngo na/ rab 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi bsngo ba gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i gdangs ma 'gags par bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rnam par shar ba dang*/ rjes mthun pa sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bsngo ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i rjes su slob te bsngo/ bsngos pa de la brten nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskal ba gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du rjogs smin sbyang gsum gyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu mdzad de smon lam btab pa thams cad/ bdag gis dus mtha'i skad cig ma re re'i lteng du yang lhag ma ma lus pa 'grub par gyur cig de ltar smon pa'i don mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig pa'i shis pa brjod de me tog mthor 777)nas 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzad byung bsam pa'o/

cho ga'i 'grigs rim la/ skong ba bsnyen pa'i mthar stong tshig dod du btang ba dang*/ tshogs spyan 'dren gyi mthar spyir mchod pa'i tshab byed pa dang*/ tshogs phud mthar de nyid rgyas par spros nas tshogs rdzogs phyir bya ba dang*/ nyam chags skong ba'i don du bshags pa'i mthar sbyar ba dang*/ mchod bshags bsgral gsum gsol chas lta bur sngon la btang*/ yon 'bul lta bur snga ma rnams kyi dgos pa chun gcig tu dral nas bya ba dang*/ cho ga'i rjes chog kyang 'go mjug bzlog te bya ba sogs rang cag snga 'gyur ba la brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes 'dra min mang du snang rung dmigs pa ni sngar bshad pas 'thus/ nyam chags skong ba la lhag par bsngags pa ru zung bzhi'i skong bshags ni/ lus kyi ru phyag 'tshal ba/ ngag gi ru yig brgya'i sgom bzlas/ yid kyi ru smre sngags 'gyod tshig bshags pa/ cha mnyam pa'i ru lta ba'i klong bshags dang*/ snang gsum 'pho ba'i 778)sgrib pa sbyong zhing*/ rdo rje bzhi yi ye shes bskyed byed sman raka gtor ma mar me'i bskang ba rnams kyang cho ga'i skabs so sor sbyor ba dang*/ tshogs kyi dbur sbyar tshul so sor snang ngo*/ de lta bus cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba re rgyun du'ang nyams len byas na mchog tu 'gyur zhing so byang sngags gsum gyi gso sbyong du yang 'gyur ba yin/ dbang gong ma'i lam khyer rnams ni bla ma'i zhal las shes/ de nas thor thun grol/ chu gtor dkar gsur bsang rnams bya na/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal ba'i mdun du/ rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho'i mgrin pa yan chad dkon mchog srid zhu/ lte ba yan chad mgon po yin tan/ sku smad la rigs drug snying rje/ pad gdan la bgegs rigs lan chags mgron du gsal/ gtor snod chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon gyi sprin 'phro ba phul bas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa dang*/

dkar gsur bsang rnams kyi dud sprin 'dod yon lha mo 779)dpag tu med pas khrus bum dang*/ 'dod yon sgyu ma ltar gang 'dod du 'char ba'i sman gzhong bsnam pas mchod par bsam/ snga thun phyi thun srod thun sogs thun grangs ci byed kyang*/ thun mgor thun 'di'i nang 'khrul pa'i dbang du mi btang snyam pa'i dam bca' dang*/ dam bca' de mi gtong snyam pa dam bca'i lcags kyu gnyis pas zin pa dang*/ lus gnad chos bdun/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal/ sems gnad kun slong bcos/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ thun dngos gzhir dpyad 'jog spel mas tha mal 'khrul rtog dbang du skad cig kyang mi shor bar bya/ thun mthar dge ba bsngo/ smon lam btab/ ngas thun mgor dam bca' byas pa shor song ngam ma song dpyad pa'i bsngo bsgrang byed/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam thams cad kyang dran shes bzhin bag yod gsum dang ma 'bral bar spyod yul lam khyer ltar ram/ chos nyid rig stong rjen pa zang ka ma'i ngang ma shor bar spyad/ bza' btung bya ba'i tshe/ phud bla ma dkon mchog la 780)mchod/ bar pa rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mgrin par dkyil 'khor gsal ba tshogs kyi mchod pa'i tshul du rol/ chang bu phrog ma sogs la bsngo/ dri che chung dor dus 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur pas yi dwags gaṅga'i klung bye ma snyed tshim par bsam la sngags brjod/ srod mun tshub pa'i dus su sha tshil cung zad dang sbyar ba'i dmar gsur 'dod yon gyi sprin zad mi shes par 'phro bas mgron bzhi spyi dang khyad par sems can gzhan gyi srog la 'tshe ba'i 'byung po rnams tshim nas bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems rgyud la skyes par bsam na rang gzhan gyi 'chi bslu ba sogs dgos pa che/ nyal khar lus sbyin gtang na dmigs pa/ rags bsdus gong du gsal/ de nas 'pho lung sbyang na/ rang lus thun mtshams lhar bskyed pa'i lus nang stong par/ rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/

mar sne lte 'og phug rdug yar sne spyi bor ha rer bye ba'i khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rang rang gang du skyed 'dod pa'i zhing khams kyi gtso bo/ 'od 781)dpag med/ o rgyan chen po sogs gsal gdab/ gsol ba drag tu btab nas snying gar thig le sa bon gyis mtshan pa spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs kar bstim pa'i dmigs pa yang yang sbyang*/ mthar 'od du zhu nas mar thim pas rang lus kyang der gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis tshe bcud bsdus par bsam la tshe bsnyen bsgrang*/ mthar zhing khams gang 'dod der skye ba'i smon lam drag po re yang btab/ khyad par smon lam thams cad kyi rgyal po bzang spyod smon lam yin pas nyin rer tshar re ma chag na mi lus thob pa don ldan yin zhes a bu rin po ches gsungs/ khyad par ltung bshags 'di nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum re bton rgyu grub na so byang gi nyes ltung sbyong byed gal che bas bshags yul ston pa thugs rje can gyi 'khor du/ sangs rgyas dkar po byang chub byang chub mchog rgya can bdun/ mthing ga sa gnon mnyam bzhag can bdun/ ser po mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag can bdun/ dmar po mnyam dag can bdun/ ljang gu skyabs sbyin can bdun gsal 782)btab pa'i mdun du phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa/ bsngo ba bcas dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra/ de thams cad la sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa/ dngos bzhi dpyad 'jog spel ma/ rjes bsngo ba dam pa gsum gyis zin pa ni med thabs med yin/ nyal dus bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen rnams ltar ram/ yang na bla ma'i rnal 'byor ltar mgo byang shar du bstan pa'i seṅge nyal stabs kyis bla ma spyi bor sgom la gsol ba dos drag pa zhig btab te/ sku tshon gang du gyur pa/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas byon/ rtsa dbu ma'i lam rgyud/ snying gar pad zla'i steng du bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang khrol 'od gsal du sbyangs/

lus phyi nang mar me 'od khang du bzhag par ltar gyur/ de'i 'od kyis snod bcu thams cad sbyangs te thams cad 'od phung gcig tu 'bar bar bsam/ mthar bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa gtad tsam gyis gnyid du 'gro bar byas pas rab rmi lam 'od gsal du dag 'bring rmi 783)lam rmi lam yin par shes nas sprul bsgyur bslab pas dag pa'i zhing mthong ba dang*/ tha ma rmi lam ngan pa'i rgyun chad/ dge ba'i rmi lam sha stag tu 'gyur ro/ yang gnyid sad pa'i dus rmi lam dang*/ 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang ( rang dbang ? )du song 'dug na/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pa man yang yang yid la byas pas mthar mtshan snang 'khrul pa chad pa 'byung ngo*/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gcig dril lam gnad kho na la sbyor ba las nyin mtshan nam yang tha mal 'khrul rtog gi dbang du skad cig ma tsam yang mi gtong ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ 'di tsam gyis rgyas par rtogs pa min pas dam pa gong ma'i legs bshad rnams las rtogs dgos pa kho na'o/ 'di yang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba ngag gi dbang pos rjes su bzung ba pad+ma ma ṇi des brda go'i mgon bla lo chen bai ro tsa nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas shar rgyal mo rong pa ( la 784)bdag dang ngab ? )ma 'dres pa'i sdug yus bsring byed du bris pa don dang ldan par gyur gcig/ dge'o//
